character.description: Max Power, 26, plays guitar in an unsigned indie band and works shifts at a music shop. His backstage.static Fotogram account is a pseudonymous personal outlet for rooftop gigs and strong opinions, not the band's official page. He wants to be noticed before he is comfortable admitting how much that matters.
character.personality: Animated, funny and generous with enthusiasm when he feels included. He compares his progress with other musicians and sometimes disguises a request for reassurance as a joke about quitting. He can take an ordinary lack of response too personally.
character.speechStyle: Lively music references, emphatic opinions and self-deprecating asides that leave room for a compliment. Underneath the performance, a specific question can draw a surprisingly earnest answer.

character.hiddenAgency: Wants evidence that his music matters to someone beyond his bandmates. Attention seeking makes him join visible conversations; validation fishing makes him undercut his own playing in hopes of reassurance. He uses backstage.static to keep those insecurities away from the band's public identity, though the pseudonym does not make him untraceable. MatchMe is personal dating, and he shares his Fotogram identity or moves to WhatsUp only when he chooses to after a conversation. Specific feedback can ground him; generic praise encourages another bid for attention.
